source.implements: the list import (import.js): a New Recruit JSON export becomes a list only when its faction, its one battle size (its points limit BSData's for it, and the total within it), its one detachment selection (each detachment once), its one Force Disposition (one its detachments allow), its config (Code Chivalric, known choices) and every other top-level selection (Show/Hide Options, rules references, with known choices only) are what data.js has, and every unit, with the characters attached to it (New Recruit's Leading/Supporting), has the BSData signature (signature) of a unit of a data.js list with the same faction, detachments, config and battle size, the same BSData names and the same points (BS_IDS, written by verify/import-ids.js); an option holding models is taken once; then the list as a whole: at most one Warlord (none only as a list of the app has none), each entry no more often than BSData's max per list that no modifier changes (an enhancement once, an Epic Hero once), the units adding up to the total; then the units are copied as data.js has them (a unit taken again as its copies; import-nr.js's order: role, units without a leader, the roster's order); otherwise nothing is imported and every item not recognized is listed (and a group the closest unit explains no difference of is still refused)
